# PDFKira - Free Online PDF Tools

> PDFKira is a free, privacy-first online PDF toolkit that processes all files locally in your browser. No uploads to servers, no sign-ups, no watermarks.

## About
PDFKira offers a complete suite of PDF tools for students, professionals, and businesses. All operations run client-side using WebAssembly (WASM) for fast, secure processing. Files are automatically deleted after use.

**Website**: https://pdfkira.com
**Privacy**: https://pdfkira.com/privacy (if you have one) or describe: 100% local processing, no server uploads.

---

---

## Key Features Across All Tools

- **100% Client-Side Processing**: Your files never leave your browser. No uploads to any server.
- **No Registration Required**: Use all tools instantly without creating an account.
- **No File Size Limits**: Process large PDFs without restrictions.
- **No Watermarks**: Output files are clean and professional.
- **Automatic File Deletion**: All temporary files are removed after processing.
- **Free to Use**: Completely free during MVP phase.

---

## Why Choose PDFKira?

PDFKira is built for users who value privacy, speed, and simplicity. Unlike many "free" PDF tools that secretly charge credit cards or upload your documents to unknown servers, PDFKira processes everything locally using WebAssembly. This means your sensitive documents stay on your device and are never exposed to the internet.

---

## Technical Implementation

PDFKira is built with:
- **React + TypeScript + Vite** for the frontend
- **pdf.js** for PDF rendering and display
- **@pdf-kit/pdf-lib** (WASM-powered) for PDF manipulation
- **Deployed on Vercel** for fast global delivery
